pose_en: She sits upright on a chair, seen from the side, next to a small table. Her right forearm rests on the table, palm facing up, holding a soft ball in her right hand with the fingers loosely around it (hand open, relaxed). Draw the hand and ball clearly and large enough to read. The arrow is a short curved arrow next to the fingers showing the fingers closing around the ball.
eind_en: END position: the same seated pose, the right hand squeezes the ball firmly, fingers tightly closed around it; the forearm stays on the table.

pose_en: She stands upright, seen from the side, facing left. Her right arm is stretched straight forward at shoulder height, palm facing DOWN, wrist straight. Her left hand holds the back of her right hand and fingers. The arrow is a curved arrow at the right hand pointing DOWN and back TOWARD her body, showing the left hand pulling the right hand and fingers down and toward her so the wrist bends.
eind_en: END position: right arm still straight forward at shoulder height, the right wrist is bent fully downward with the fingers pointing to the floor and slightly back toward her body, the left hand holding the back of the right hand and pulling it toward her.

naam: Pols achterover buigen – met hulp op tafel
pose_en: Close side view of her right forearm and hand at a table, she sits facing right. The right forearm lies flat on the table top, the WRIST is exactly at the table edge and the whole right hand sticks out freely in the air beyond the edge, palm DOWN, level with the forearm. Her left hand is under the fingertips of the right hand. The arrow is a curved arrow at the right hand pointing UPWARD: the hand bends up at the wrist while the forearm stays on the table.
eind_en: END position: the right forearm still lies flat on the table, wrist at the edge; ONLY the hand is bent up at the wrist (fingers toward the ceiling), the left hand under the fingers pushing up gently. The forearm never lifts.

pose_en: She sits on a chair at a table, seen from the FRONT and slightly from above so the whole table top is visible. Her ENTIRE right forearm and right hand lie flat ON the table top, pointing straight forward away from her body (forearm parallel to the table edge's perpendicular), palm down, wrist straight, fingers together; the hand does NOT hang over any edge. Her right hand appears on the LEFT side of the image; its thumb points toward the middle of her body. The arrow is a short curved arrow at the fingertips pointing toward the THUMB side, i.e. toward her body's midline (to the RIGHT in the image), showing the hand sliding sideways over the table while the forearm stays still. Her left hand rests in her lap.
eind_en: END position: the right forearm is unchanged on the table, the right hand is slid sideways at the wrist toward the thumb side, palm still flat on the table.

naam: Handpalm naar boven draaien tegen elastiek
pose_en: She sits on a chair at a table, seen from the FRONT. Her right forearm rests on the table, elbow bent at 90 degrees and close to her body, right palm facing DOWN. A flat elastic resistance band is looped around her right hand; her left hand holds the other end of the band on the table, keeping it slightly taut. The arrow is a curved arrow around the right forearm showing the forearm turning so the palm turns UP.
eind_en: END position: same pose, the right forearm has rotated so the right palm faces UP, the elastic band is stretched and taut, the left hand still holds its end.

pose_en: She stands upright, seen from the FRONT. Her right arm is held out to the side with the elbow bent and pointing sideways slightly below shoulder height; her right thumb and index finger touch to form a circle (OK sign), the other fingers straight, and the right hand is at ear height next to her head, palm facing forward. Her left arm hangs relaxed. The arrow is a curved arrow from the right hand toward her right eye, showing the hand turning so the circle moves over the eye.
eind_en: END position: the right elbow is raised out to the side at shoulder height, the circle of thumb and index finger is placed over the right eye like a mask, the other fingers point backwards along the side of the head, palm facing forward.

pose_en: She stands upright, seen from the side, facing left. Her right arm is stretched straight forward at shoulder height, palm facing FORWARD (away from her), fingers pointing UP, wrist bent back. Her left hand holds the fingers of the right hand. The arrow is a curved arrow at the right fingers pointing back TOWARD her body, showing the left hand pulling the fingers toward her.
eind_en: END position: right arm still straight forward, the right wrist bent further back, fingers pulled toward her by the left hand, palm facing forward.

naam: Pols voorover buigen – met hulp op tafel
pose_en: Close side view, she sits facing right at a table. Her right forearm lies flat on the table, palm facing UP, the wrist exactly at the table edge and the hand free in the air beyond the edge, level. Her left hand is under the back of the right hand. The arrow is a curved arrow at the right hand pointing UPWARD: the hand curls up at the wrist toward the forearm while the forearm stays on the table.
eind_en: END position: right forearm still flat on the table palm up; ONLY the hand is bent up at the wrist toward the forearm (wrist flexion), the left hand under the back of the hand helping.

pose_en: Seen from the front, she sits upright. Her palms and fingers are pressed together in front of her breastbone, fingers pointing up, elbows out to the sides. The arrow is a straight arrow next to the hands pointing DOWN, showing the joined hands sliding down while the palms stay together.
eind_en: END position: hands lowered to in front of the upper belly, palms still pressed flat together, fingers pointing up, elbows lower and wider, wrists strongly bent back.

naam: Pols buigen en strekken – duim omhoog
pose_en: Close side view, she sits facing right at a table. Her right forearm rests on the table on its little-finger side, thumb pointing UP, wrist at the table edge, hand free beyond the edge, wrist straight, fingers relaxed. The arrow is a curved arrow at the hand pointing DOWN-forward, showing the hand bending at the wrist (and then back).
eind_en: END position: same forearm position thumb up; the hand is bent at the wrist toward the palm side (palm moves toward the forearm), fingers relaxed.

pose_en: Seen from the front, she sits upright. Both forearms are held in front of her, elbows bent, hands relaxed, wrists straight, palms facing down. ONE circular arrow around the right hand shows the hand drawing circles at the wrist.
eind_en: END position: same, the hands have turned at the wrists and are now bent to the side and up in the circle; forearms stay still.

naam: Onderarm draaien – handpalm op en neer
pose_en: Seen from the front, she sits at a table. Her right forearm rests on the table, elbow bent at 90 degrees close to her side, palm facing DOWN. Her left hand rests lightly on the right forearm near the wrist. The arrow is a curved arrow around the right forearm showing it rotating so the palm turns UP.
eind_en: END position: the right forearm is rotated so the palm faces UP, elbow still bent beside the body, left hand still on the right forearm helping.

naam: Onderarm draaien met een halter of hamer
pose_en: Seen from the front, she sits at a table. Her right forearm rests on the table, elbow bent at 90 degrees, holding a hammer by the END of the handle with the hammer head pointing straight UP, thumb up. The arrow is a curved arrow at the hammer head showing it tilting slowly to one side (forearm rotation).
eind_en: END position: the forearm has rotated so the palm faces up and the hammer head points sideways away from her body, handle tilted; forearm stays on the table.

naam: Handpalm naar beneden draaien tegen elastiek
pose_en: Seen from the front, she sits at a table. Her right forearm rests on the table, elbow bent at 90 degrees beside her body, palm facing UP. A flat elastic resistance band is looped around her right hand; her left hand holds the other end on the table, band slightly taut. The arrow is a curved arrow around the right forearm showing it rotating so the palm turns DOWN.
eind_en: END position: right forearm rotated so the palm faces DOWN (back of the hand visible), elbow still bent beside the body, the band stretched taut.

naam: Pols omhoog duwen tegen je hand (zonder bewegen)
pose_en: Close side view, she sits facing right at a table. Her right forearm and hand lie flat on the table, palm DOWN, wrist straight. Her left hand lies on the back of the right hand, holding it down. A short straight arrow on the back of the right hand points UP, showing the right hand pushing up against the left hand without moving.
eind_en: This is a static isometric hold: show the woman ONCE, in exactly the drawn position, muscles of the forearm slightly tensed.

naam: Pols buigen tegen je hand (zonder bewegen)
pose_en: Close side view, she sits facing right at a table. Her right forearm and hand lie flat on the table, palm UP, wrist straight. Her left hand lies in the right palm, holding it down. A short straight arrow in the right palm points UP, showing the right hand pushing up against the left hand without moving.
eind_en: This is a static isometric hold: show the woman ONCE, in exactly the drawn position, muscles of the forearm slightly tensed.

naam: Pols naar de duimkant optillen met gewicht
pose_en: Close side view, she sits facing right at a table. Her right forearm rests on the table on its little-finger side, thumb UP, wrist at the table edge, hand beyond the edge holding a hammer by the end of the handle with the hammer head pointing forward, wrist tilted slightly down. The arrow is a curved arrow at the hammer head pointing UP, showing the hand tilting up toward the thumb side.
eind_en: END position: forearm unchanged on the table thumb up; the hand is tilted up toward the thumb side so the hammer head points upward and back.

pose_en: Seen from the front, she sits upright. She holds a rubber flexbar (a thick ribbed rubber bar) vertically in front of her chest with both hands, right hand at the bottom, left hand at the top, elbows bent, wrists straight. The arrow is a curved arrow at the top hand showing it twisting forward, like wringing out a towel.
eind_en: END position: same grip, the top wrist is bent forward and the bottom wrist bent back, the flexbar visibly twisted and bent.

pose_en: Close view from the front-side of her right forearm resting on a table, palm UP, fingers fully straight and relaxed, wrist straight. The arrow is a curved arrow at the fingertips pointing toward the palm, showing the fingers closing into a fist.
eind_en: END position: the right hand makes a full fist (thumb over the fingers), forearm unchanged on the table.

pose_en: Close side view, she sits facing right. Her right elbow rests on the table with the forearm pointing UP, wrist straight, fingers straight and together pointing up, palm facing her. The arrow is a curved arrow at the fingers showing them bending forward ONLY at the knuckles toward her.
eind_en: END position: same forearm; the fingers are bent 90 degrees at the knuckles while the fingers themselves stay straight (like a small table top), thumb relaxed.

pose_en: Close side view, she sits facing right. Her right elbow rests on the table with the forearm pointing UP, wrist straight, fingers straight and together pointing up, palm facing her. The arrow is a curved arrow at the fingertips showing the fingertips curling down toward the palm.
eind_en: END position: same forearm; the finger joints are curled so the fingertips touch the top of the palm (hook fist), while the knuckles stay straight (fingers' base in line with the hand).

pose_en: Close view from the front: her right forearm upright with the elbow on a table, palm facing the viewer, fingertips and thumb tip held close together with a small rubber band around all five fingers. The arrow is a curved arrow beside the fingers pointing outward, showing the fingers spreading apart.
eind_en: END position: same forearm; fingers and thumb spread wide apart, the rubber band stretched around them.

naam: Vingers buigen en strekken met hulp
pose_en: Close view, she sits at a table. Her right forearm rests on the table on its little-finger side, wrist straight, fingers straight and relaxed. Her left hand is wrapped around the fingers of the right hand. The arrow is a curved arrow at the right fingers pointing toward the palm, showing the left hand gently bending the right fingers into the palm.
eind_en: END position: the left hand has gently bent all fingers of the right hand fully into the palm; right forearm unchanged.

pose_en: Close side view. Her right elbow rests on a table with the forearm pointing up, wrist straight. A small lump of therapy putty is held between the thumb tip and the fingertips, fingers straight. Draw ONE small arrow at the thumb pointing toward the fingertips, showing the squeeze.
eind_en: END position: same forearm, the putty squeezed flat between thumb and straight fingertips.

pose_en: Close view from above of her right hand lying flat on a table, palm UP, fingers straight together, thumb stretched out beside the hand. The arrow is a curved arrow at the thumb tip pointing across the palm toward the little finger.
eind_en: END position: same hand palm up on the table; the thumb is bent across the palm with its tip near the base of the little finger, fingers stay straight.

naam: Duim zijwaarts van de hand bewegen
pose_en: Close view FROM ABOVE of her right hand and forearm lying completely flat ON the table top (not over any edge), palm facing UP, fingers straight and together, the THUMB lying flat against the side of the index finger. Only her forearm and hand, plus a little of her body at the top edge, are visible. The arrow is a short curved arrow next to the thumb tip, in the plane of the table, pointing sideways AWAY from the index finger.
eind_en: END position: same close view from above, hand still flat on the table palm up, fingers straight together; the thumb has slid sideways over the table surface, wide away from the index finger, staying flat in the plane of the table (it does NOT lift up toward the ceiling).

pose_en: Close side view of her right hand lying flat on a table, palm DOWN, fingers together, thumb flat on the table beside the hand. The arrow is a short curved arrow at the thumb pointing UP off the table.
eind_en: END position: same hand flat palm down on the table; ONLY the thumb is lifted up off the table as high as possible.

naam: Elleboog buigen en strekken met hulp
pose_en: Seen from the side (facing right), she sits upright on a chair. Her right arm hangs down along her body, elbow straight, palm facing forward. Her left hand holds her right forearm near the wrist. The arrow is a curved arrow at the right hand pointing UP toward the shoulder, showing the elbow bending.
eind_en: END position: the right elbow fully bent, right fingers near the shoulder, palm toward the shoulder, the left hand at the right wrist helping push it further.

pose_en: Seen from the FRONT, she stands upright. Her right arm hangs along her body, rotated inward so the back of the hand faces forward, the hand making a fist with the wrist bent toward the palm. The arrow is a curved arrow at the right hand pointing backward and slightly out to the side, showing the straight arm moving back and out.
eind_en: END position: the straight right arm moved a little backward and out to the side, still turned inward with the fist and bent wrist, her head gently tilted to the LEFT (away from the arm).

pose_en: Seen from the FRONT, she stands upright. Her right arm is out to the side, elbow bent about 90 degrees, palm facing UP like carrying a tray at shoulder level, fingers pointing away from her. The arrow is a curved arrow at the right hand pointing outward, showing the arm straightening out to the side.
eind_en: END position: right arm straight out to the side at shoulder height, palm up, wrist bent back with fingers pointing down toward the floor, head gently tilted to the LEFT (away from the arm).
